name: Higueras (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and green, the middle of double width, charged with a green fig tree with a white trunk.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 3 February 2004 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 4695 of 19 February 2004; it is a flag of 2:3, tierced horizontally, the second third of double width, the outer thirds vert and the middle or charged with a fig tree vert with a trunk argent.

features.role: fig tree with a white trunk
